title: news_raw_payload_v1
description: Raw (dirty) news-like message from an upstream provider. This is intentionally permissive to reflect real-world feeds.

body.description: May contain HTML, emojis, inconsistent punctuation, etc.

published_at.description: Provider time. Often missing or in inconsistent formats.

language.description: BCP-47 like en/zh, but may be wrong.

symbols.description: May contain duplicates, mixed formats (AAPL, 000001.SZ, etc).

raw.description: Optional nested object for provider-specific fields.
